varnished hardwood.source: Density: hardwood 600-800 kg/m³. Bounce chosen so a superball on it gives Cross's measured 0.86.

domino wood.source: Hardwood; domino-on-domino values calibrated to Larham's measured wave speed.

hollow plastic.source: Polyethylene 910-960 kg/m³; e from a 92 cm drop rebounding 43.6 cm with drag removed (Physics Factbook).

solid rubber.source: 102.5 g, 60 mm superball (Cross, Am. J. Phys. 70, 482 and 1093, 2002); e 0.86 on a wood floor.

contacts.source: Dry wood on wood friction 0.25-0.5 (Engineering ToolBox); restitution provisional.
A hollow hard plastic ball dropped 92 cm rebounded 43.6 cm (Physics Factbook), e 0.75 with drag removed. Friction: polyethylene on wood (Murase 1984).
Restitution 0.86 and friction 0.52: Cross, Am. J. Phys. 70, 482 (2002); sideways e_x 0.49-0.76 (Cross 2002; Garwin 1969). Rolling resistance provisional.
Calibrated: the domino wave runs 1.49 sqrt(gH), Larham's measured 1.50 (arXiv:1302.3311).
